host_profiles.integration_status: V17 integrated physical acceptance passed; integrity only

limitations: FIONREAD samples bytes queued at two instants, not arrival history or ACK identity.
Read wall time includes blocking and scheduling; bytes may arrive during an unobserved pause.
Two extra ioctls per read add experimental overhead; no production change.

gui_trace.limitation: Active A0 callbacks only; render callback excludes later asynchronous Qt paint events. Overlap with a delayed ACK does not alone establish causality.
